biography: Oscar Garcia's journey began amidst the bustling karting scene of Jakarta, Indonesia. From a young age, he displayed a raw talent, mastering the art of wheel-to-wheel combat on the tight, unforgiving circuits. His father, a former mechanic, poured his savings into Oscar's racing dreams, working tirelessly to keep the kart running. A defining moment came at the Indonesian National Karting Championship in 2018, where a daring last-lap overtake secured him the title, earning him national recognition. Moving into single-seaters, Oscar faced financial hurdles, often relying on crowdfunding and small sponsorships to keep his career afloat. Currently racing as an independent driver in Formula Regional, he aims to prove his mettle against factory-backed rivals, hoping for a shot at Formula 2. He is known for his flamboyant personality, often seen sporting custom-designed helmets and eye-catching race suits, determined to make a name for himself on the international stage.
drivingStyle: Oscar is an aggressive, attacking driver known for his late-braking maneuvers and fearless overtakes. He thrives under pressure, often pulling off stunning moves in the closing laps of races. While his raw speed is undeniable, tire management remains a work in progress. He tends to overdrive the car early in stints, sacrificing long-run pace for initial gains. However, he is actively working on refining his technique, learning to balance aggression with consistency.

rivalries.reason: Rossi, a factory driver with extensive resources, views Garcia as a disruptive upstart trying to steal his spotlight. Their on-track battles are often intense and physical.
Tanaka and Garcia clashed frequently in their karting days, with several controversial incidents leading to a bitter rivalry that has carried over into their single-seater careers.

Dubois is another driver with considerable financial backing. Garcia believes she is only in her racing position due to her family connections and has publicly called out what he calls 'pay-to-win' racing.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky wristband given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Listens to Indonesian Gamelan music to calm his nerves before getting into the car.
Refuses to wash his racing gloves during a race weekend, believing it brings him good luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. And I've got enough heart for the whole damn grid!"
careerHighlight: Winning the 2018 Indonesian National Karting Championship with a daring last-lap overtake, proving his potential to the nation.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2022 Formula Regional season due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential championship victory.
